name: Cymbal
overview: Scripture reveals that cymbals, made of brass, played a significant role in the worship and ceremonial life of Israel, particularly in the tabernacle and temple services. They were used by the Levites alongside other musical instruments to praise and thank the LORD on special occasions such as the laying of the foundation of the second temple and the dedication of Jerusalem's wall. The unified sound of cymbals, trumpets, and singing was a powerful expression of worship, often accompanied by God's manifest presence, as seen when the house of the LORD was filled with a cloud during praise.
